## Pre-failure, not health

`health-monitor` already mails `zfs_pool_health` and `smart_status` every morning. Both are pass/fail, and SMART reports PASSED until the drive is gone.

This watches what moves first -- wear, spare blocks, reallocated and pending sectors, media errors -- and the *rate* the wear indicator climbs, so the projection arrives months before the verdict does.

It sends nothing itself. Everything goes to the spine, which owns suppression.
